top_signals.title: Pictet Adds Japan Stocks in Diversification Push After Midterms
top_signals.summary: Pictet Asset Management has added more Japanese shares to one of its multi-asset portfolios following the US midterm elections, in a bid to diversify and seek opportunities beyond stocks that are directly tied to artificial intelligence.
